name: Google (sign in)
summary: @(Gmail and Google Workspace accounts, signing in with Google instead of an app password.)
redirectNote: @(Return address to register in Google Cloud, under Authorized redirect URIs.)

steps.text: @(Enter your email address, then choose Sign in with Google.)
@(Approve the access Google asks for. Your password never reaches TotalMail.)

setup.text: @(Create an OAuth client of type Web application in Google Cloud.)
@(Add the return address shown here under Authorized redirect URIs, and add the Gmail scope https://mail.google.com/ to the consent screen.)
@(Put the client ID and the secret in the administrator window, then try again.)

note: @(Sign-in with this provider is not set up on this server. Ask the administrator to add the application ID.)
